answer: A sybil tax blocks bulk fake identities. Each new agent burns a sunk fee of 50 credits before trading; no receipt, no entry. At the dawn of each epoch, a kernel of agents verifies receipts and history, while a grove of witnesses cross-checks them, so one corrupt checker cannot admit fakes. Forging 1,000 identities costs 50,000 credits, far above the 2,000 a fake ring could earn. An honest agent pays 50 once and keeps its full, undiluted rewards.
